note.scripts: The chart editor's scripts aren't loaded.
field.invalid: The spec isn't valid JSON, so the chart can't be drawn.
field.codeData: This chart's data comes from code, so the preview has no data.
title: Edit chart
autosaveNote: Changes go into the page as you make them.
undone: Undid the changes made since the editor opened.
codeHelp: The Vega or Vega-Lite spec, in JSON. Changes here update the visual controls and the preview, and changes there update this.
frozen: The code isn't valid JSON (line %(line)s: %(error)s). The settings and preview show the last valid chart until it's fixed.
unrepresentable: The visual settings can't show this spec: %(problem)s. Keep editing it in the code, or start a new chart from the data.
noData: The visual settings need a dataset with data in this form. Add data to the chart, or edit the spec in the code.
codeData: This chart's data comes from code, so the visual settings aren't available. Edit the spec in the code.
pending: This suggested chart isn't in the page yet: change a setting or pick a suggestion to add it.
suggestionsHelp: Start from a chart that suits the data's columns. It replaces the chart type and fields below.
arrangement: Bars or areas that share a position
arrangementHint.bar: Choose a colour field to split the bars into parts.
arrangementHint.area: Choose a colour field to split the areas into parts.
point: Show a point for each value
donut: Donut (leave a hole in the middle)
tooltip: Show values in a tooltip on hover or focus
keptIntro: The settings don't edit these parts of the spec. They're kept as they are:
droppedIntro: Your changes remove these parts of the spec:
sort.ascending: Ascending (A to Z, low to high)
sort.descending: Descending (Z to A, high to low)
channel.column: Columns (a small chart for each value)
channel.row: Rows (a small chart for each value)
problem.vega: it's a Vega spec, and the settings make Vega-Lite charts
problem.composite: it combines several views (it has “%(key)s”), and the settings make one view at a time
problem.mark: they don't offer its mark type, “%(mark)s”
problem.data: it doesn't load its data from one of the chart's datasets by name
suggest.lines: Lines: %(y)s over time, one for each %(color)s
missingDataset: The spec uses the dataset “%(missing)s”, which this chart doesn't have. The settings show “%(name)s”; changing one switches the spec to it.
codeDatasetUsed: The spec uses “%(missing)s”, whose data comes from code and can't be previewed here. The settings show “%(name)s”; changing one switches the spec to it.
startedFresh: Started a new chart from a suggestion.
datasetFields: “%(name)s” doesn't have the fields the chart used, so it starts from a suggestion.
widthAuto: Width set to automatic: charts split into rows or columns can't fill the page width.
swapped: Swapped the X and Y axes.
previewError: The preview can't be drawn yet: %(error)s
sampled: The preview shows the first %(shown)s of %(total)s rows. The chart on the page uses them all.
error.scripts: The data editor's scripts aren't loaded.
